description:
Fintech and traditional banks both manage money, but they work very differently. Fintech companies use digital technology, mobile apps, and automation to deliver faster payments, lower fees, and better user experiences. Traditional banks rely on physical branches, established systems, and strict regulations that focus on stability and trust. This simple comparison explains how fintech is transforming modern finance and why both systems still play an important role today.
